facts.fact: Africa Top Success reports the National Assembly voted the cybersecurity and anti-cybercrime bill by acclamation on 25 January 2024, with promulgation by the President expected within days; it sets 6 to 10 years' imprisonment and fines of 5 to 10 million CFA francs.
